gitCommit.subject: M6 polish: dialogs above toasts, a tidier victory dialog, clearer sprouts
gitCommit.body:
M6 polish: dialogs above toasts, a tidier victory dialog, clearer sprouts

- Dialogs now sit above the toasts, and leaving a world clears its toasts.
- The victory dialog keeps its buttons in view (the traveller list scrolls)
  and no longer calls a beginner 'best at mining'.
- The menu's Save game button says 'Saved' once the save is done.
- The research count sits beside the tech tree's bar instead of floating.
- Wheat and sunroot sprouts are easier to see.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
